title: Starr County Flood Evidence Collection
purpose: Shared collection of flood events, flood susceptibility, weather, terrain, public reports, and public infrastructure or closure evidence for the initial project dataset.

geography.name: Starr County, Texas
geography.boundary_policy: Include an event when its claimed location is in Starr County or its documented footprint overlaps Starr County.

record_sets.description: Documented flood events and supplementary public reports.

source_families.description: Historical documented flood events and official incident or disaster records.
Weather observations and rainfall or event data.
Terrain, elevation, hydrography, and drainage-related layers.
Local news and permitted public Facebook, Instagram, and X material.
Public roads, drainage infrastructure, closures, and service reports.

processed_layers.description: Map-ready GeoJSON imported from the earlier Flood Project working directory; see flood-hazard-layers/manifest.json.

primary_discovery_sources: FEMA disaster declarations and local agency records
NOAA NCEI Daily Summaries and Local Climatological Data
TWDB Flood Planning Data Hub and Lower Rio Grande Region 15 materials
Hidalgo County Drainage District No. 1 and local government public records
